description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicEndpoint class in the QUIC protocol simulation, including tests for transmission, write blocking, two-way communication, and multiple hosts competition.

classes.name: QuicEndpointTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for QUIC endpoint simulation tests, setting up a network switch and links.

classes.name: QuicEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a simulated QUIC endpoint in the network test environment.

classes.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer
classes.description: Manages multiple QUIC endpoints communicating with a common destination.

classes.name: Simulator
classes.description: Simulates network conditions and runs the test scenarios.

classes.name: Switch
classes.description: Represents a network switch connecting endpoints.

classes.name: SymmetricLink
classes.description: Represents a network link with symmetric properties between endpoints.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Creates a symmetric network link between two endpoints.

methods.description: Creates a network link with custom RTT delay.

methods.description: Queues data for transfer in the endpoint.

methods.description: Returns the number of bytes transferred by the endpoint.

methods.description: Returns the number of bytes received by the endpoint.
